name: nocturn-audit
description: Security audit CLI with measured precision: OWASP Top 10 rules, a synthetic canary for recall, and a CI gate that stops precision from regressing.

scripts.denetim: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js scan
scripts.denetim:proje: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js scan
scripts.denetim:hizli: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js scan --static
scripts.yeni-kural: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js yeni-kural
scripts.new-rule: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js new-rule
scripts.audit: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js scan
scripts.verify: npm run build --silent && npm test --silent && node dist/cli.js precision --ci && node dist/cli.js recall --ci
